thread:
jamal: Quick follow-up from today's postmortem (GPU saturation + autoscale gaps). I want clear owners and deadlines — listing proposed actions below. Please ack or update owners.

maria: Ack. I can take scheduler tuning.

alex: I can own quota/backstop policy.

kyra: I'll do headroom baseline and stress runs.

devex: I'll add an eval set for regression alerts and a dashboard tile.

jamal: Actions (short):
- A1 Quota & backstop: Alex — due 2024-03-28 — deliverable: quota table + emergency reserve plan
- A2 Scheduler tuning: Maria — due 2024-04-04 — deliverable: config diff + perf run notes
- A3 Headroom baseline: Kyra — due 2024-03-25 — deliverable: headroom per pool + 48h stress results
- A4 Canary autoscale thresholds + fallback: Jamal — due 2024-04-01 — deliverable: rollout plan + rollback criteria
- A5 Recurring incident pattern detection: DevEx — due 2024-03-30 — deliverable: alert rules + weekly report

alex: I'll start the quota audit today. Ping me if you have workloads that need immediate reserve.

maria: For scheduler tuning, propose these quick tests:
```
- reduce preemption window: 20% -> 10%
- fairness weight cap: 1.0 -> 0.8
- enable soft-priority timeout: 30s
```
I'll run a staging pass by EOD Thu.

kyra: Need access to historical burst traces. @product-ops can you export last 30 days of GPU utilization per pool?

product-ops: On it. I'll drop csv to #incidents by EOD today.

devex: Adding pattern detection to the incident dashboard. Plan: group by job labels, look for 3-occurrence patterns within 7d. Will add daily digest.

sre-bot: Reminder set: weekly check-in thread in #incidents every Tue 10:00am for owners.

jamal: Great. Two immediate asks: (1) Alex, temp reserve rule to prevent >95% pool util for 5m. (2) Maria, prioritize fairness test in staging.

alex: Will implement reserve rule as a Kubernetes quota override + alert.

maria: Prioritizing.

kyra: I'll schedule the 48h stress to start tomorrow 02:00 UTC.

jamal: Thanks all. We'll reconvene next Tue in the weekly check-in. If anything slips, update the tracker in the shared Google sheet: https://docs.google.com/..../gpu-remediation

maria: :thumbsup:

alex: :thumbsup:
